pages.text: Dry nine fresh leaves for three dried tobacco. A cigarette has one draw.
A cigar has three draws and a larger $(l:psychedelicraft:effects/tobacco)saturation boost$(/l) per draw.

pages.title: Another Route
pages.text: Carry dried tobacco to use a pipe or bong. Check $(l:psychedelicraft:advanced/villagers)farmer and dealer offers$(/l) for leaves, seeds and smoking products.
